nodes.label: Where AI is actually used: YAML generation vs. Run Validation (investigation)
nodes.rationale: Investigation-only: confirmed by grep that Run Validation (webapp -> runner.start_validation() -> subprocess python main.py) contains zero AI imports/calls anywhere in Project/ — Python-only, matching the stated client claim. The '[SQLQueryGenerator] AI generation active' log line instead comes from YAML generation (SQLQueryGenerator.__init__ in src/generated_queries/sql_query_generator.py), printed once per table when QueryOutputManager builds a SQLQueryGenerator, unrelated to Run Validation timing coincidence in the console. Flagged a separate real discrepancy: SQLQueryGenerator hard-fails on use_ai=False, meaning the SQL-text-generation step is AI-mandatory for every table, not just for resolving ambiguous column names — narrower/different from the old fully-removed 100%-AI ai_transformation/orchestrator.py pattern, but still broader than the 'AI only for ambiguous columns' claim.
